scenario:
A leading medical college is developing an advanced Admission Management System to streamline the student application and evaluation process. This system is designed to handle a large number of applications, ensuring efficient processing and fair assessment of candidates based on their academic records and entrance exam scores.

The system needs to capture detailed information about each applicant, including personal details, academic achievements in secondary and higher secondary education, and performance in the Medical and Dental College Admission Test (MDCAT). The platform should also track the detailed scores in key subjects such as Chemistry, Physics, and Biology, which are crucial for admission decisions.

The Admission Management System must be capable of calculating an aggregate score based on a predefined formula to rank applicants accordingly. The system should support complex reporting and analytics to help the admissions committee make informed decisions. It should also incorporate features to handle any appeals or revisions in submitted information.

The solution should provide a robust user management system, allowing different roles such as admissions officers, evaluators, and administrative staff to access and manage data with appropriate permissions. The platform should facilitate communication with applicants, providing updates on application status and facilitating the submission of additional documents if required.
